description: Common home rows of the bench comparisons (PROC-02.d): a comparison between Homepage, native Jellyfin and KefinTweaks is equivalent only when the rows it measures are the same on both sides. Each row gives, per target, a regular expression matched against the label the browser bench records for a row with cards (Homepage: its jux-widget class; native and KefinTweaks: the row title, English UI). null: the target has no such row. Read by bench/section-manifest.mjs. KefinTweaks equivalents from the audit V5 bench (KefinTweaks 0.5.3, native rows kept by its configuration).
